scope: Only absolute endpoint movement. HistData bid minutes 2023 and 2024 only. No 2025 access. No trades.
model: Reuse Phase 3 standardized gold-only logistic regression, unpenalized intercept, L2 mean-loss strength 0.001 chosen in all four Phase 3 inner folds. Final refit through 2024-12-30 UTC, no calibration fitted. Capture numerical coefficients and hashes. No live refit.
target: abs(10000*ln(bid_M15_close_at_t_plus_60m/bid_M15_close_at_t)) > 1.5 * trailing four-quarter realized log-return volatility in bp. Strict inequality, full M1 paths for both feature and outcome windows.

reference_models.seasonal: train-only UTC-hour incidence with global fallback
reference_models.previous_volatility: logistic on log trailing H1 realized volatility in bp
reference_models.threshold_distance: logistic on log of upper threshold distance in USD/oz
reference_models.threshold_and_hour: log-distance logistic plus UTC-hour one-hot (regularized effects)

development_audit: One 4-quarter expanding comparison on gold-only complete paths in 2024. Freeze the same lambda 0.001 for all logistic fits. Fit on 2023 onward with one-day train/test embargo and one day before each outer end. Audit registered targets only: relative phase-3 target, fixed abs change >5 USD/oz, fixed abs log return >25 bp. Model specification never selected from these results. Threshold feature for a fixed target refers to its known fixed dollar distance or equivalent. Paired daily 5-day block bootstrap 10000 draws, seed 1951, one-sided Bonferroni 0.05/12 and nominal 95% CI. Developer evidence only.
live: MT5 bid only until another source is qualified. UTC: issue at a 15-minute boundary from 09:00 through 23:00 Africa/Tripoli inclusive weekdays. Watch advancing quote; age <=90s and issue <=90s after boundary. Issue time must precede outcome. Horizon anchored to completed bar; settle after actual issue time plus 60min, using exactly 60 future M1 bars from anchor, never substituting a tick or later candle. Known maintenance/weekend windows denied; other no-quote windows recorded unavailable, not silently called holidays.
alert: Fixed raw research cutoff >=0.60. Dry-run candidates logged for every valid slot. At most one Telegram attempt in any 60 min across restarts; ambiguous delivery is not retried. Default disabled. Explicit separate credentials and owner activation required. Arabic text labels uncalibrated score and uncertain direction.
pilot: First 20 days with at least one issued pilot forecast; also report all intervening weekdays including outages and all eligible slots. Cap forecast collection after 20 pilot issue days. Keep smoke and independently reserved Jan-Jun 2027 cohorts out of pilot. No requirement to start an independent cohort automatically.
gates: Operational pilot success requires >=90% issued of requested non-maintenance slots and >=95% resolved of matured issued forecasts after a 72h recovery budget. Statistical indicative pass needs >=500 settled, >=30 positives, >=20 threshold positives predicted, absolute calibration bias <=0.05, FPR <=0.20, and positive Brier gain over every reference with one-sided 0.05/4 lower bound using daily blocks. Pilot alone never validates model. If skill fails retain evidence and freeze direction/trading research. Independent cohort Jan-Jun 2027 requires separately starting frozen artifact with prospective ledger, apply same gates and >=60 issue days. No automatic promotion.
drift: Report reference training incidence and mean forecast. Flag absolute 7-issued-day changes of >=0.10 in event incidence or mean forecast versus training, and skill deterioration when rolling Brier gain vs threshold/hour is negative. Suppress inference/warnings about drift until at least 100 resolved. Quantify alert metrics separately from delivery.
llm: Groq reviewer optional and manually invoked; no live inference dependence.
